```yaml
name: Release: Cut

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      reason:
        description: 'Reason for cutting a new release candidate'
        required: false
        default: 'Scheduled release'

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  cut-candidate-branch:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Configure Git
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Check for existing candidate branch
        id: check_branch
        run: |
          if git ls-remote --heads origin release/candidate | grep -q release/candidate; then
            echo "exists=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "exists=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Delete existing candidate branch if present
        if: steps.check_branch.outputs.exists == 'true'
        run: |
          echo "Deleting existing release/candidate branch..."
          git push origin --delete release/candidate || true

      - name: Create release/candidate branch
        run: |
          git checkout -b release/candidate
          git push origin release/candidate
          echo "Created release/candidate branch from main"

      - name: Trigger Release Please
        run: |
          echo "Release/candidate branch created. Release Please workflow will auto-trigger on this branch."
          echo "Ensure release-please.yml is configured to listen to push events on release/candidate."
```
